exposure: Mode of healthcare financing (out-of-pocket, health insurance, other)
Healthcare financing models for antenatal and delivery care
outcome: Proportion of women using each mode of healthcare financing for antenatal care
Proportion of women using each mode of healthcare financing for delivery care
cohort: Pregnant and postpartum women at a tertiary health facility in South-West Nigeria over a four-year period (2016-2019 for antenatal care, 2018-2019 for delivery care)
finding: Despite the availability of health insurance for over a decade, out-of-pocket payment remains the predominant mode of healthcare financing for maternal healthcare at the tertiary health facility.
